svg.text: PR #2268 · Share typed dashboard requests over the user WebSocket
Launcher dialogs used separate REST calls and user sockets;
one shared socket now correlates replies without replaying side effects.
BEFORE
AFTER
Launch / Computers / Import
Separate REST requests for each host operation
User sockets mounted in dashboard and Computers
Live updates and request replies travel separately
ClientWebSocketProvider
One user connection survives route changes
Typed DashboardRequest + request_id
Launchers, probes, login, install and imports
REST launcher handlers
Owner checks and launcher capability checks
Directory / Agent response families
Existing host-side request correlation
DashboardResult + existing handlers
Concurrent jobs retain the same ownership checks
32 pending requests per socket / browser broker
Linked grants cannot bypass host permissions
Per-call HTTP lifecycle
No shared browser correlation for launcher calls
Separate call sites parse status and response bodies
Route changes create another user connection
Bounded broker + disconnect handling
Reply UUID selects the correct pending caller
Cancelled waiters and late replies are discarded
Disconnect reports an unknown outcome; no replay
REST remains for older clients. A disconnected mutation may already have completed; inspect state before retrying.
